PanelDescription.SourceString: 说话很奇怪的绵叫住了你，它似乎想让「勇者大人」给它打工？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A Fuzzy with a bizarre dialect stopped you. It seems to want to recruit the adventurer for a few odd jobs?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前往火山完成任务吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to the volcano and complete the quest!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 工作完成，但突然出现的绵让你意识到，背后似乎另有隐情。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The work is done, but the Fuzzy that suddenly appeared makes you suspect there's more going on beneath the surface.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 当面与烤核绵对峙，要怎么解决呢？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Now that you're face-to-face with Eval Fuzzy, how are you gonna settle this?

Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Ice Plains</> and defeat <blue>Frostcrown Stag</>
Go to <blue>Ice Plains</> and defeat <blue>Bushtail Fox</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 打工吧！勇者大人！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Hero is a Part-Timer!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 工作闭环了，跟烤核绵拉齐一下。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Project loop closed. Time to touch base with the Eval Fuzzy.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 你决定诱导烤核绵说出上线，打工，我要直接跟老板谈！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You decide to get Eval Fuzzy to spill who's really in charge. If I'm doing this gig, I'm talking to the boss directly!

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Lake</> and defeat <blue>Moss Ox</>
Go to the <blue>Lake</> and defeat <blue>Scroll-leaf Scorpion</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 找到教父绵交涉，不要中间商赚差价！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Find Godfather Fuzzy and talk to him directly!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 完成任务，回去向教父绵交付成果吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Quest complete. Time to deliver the goods to Godfather Fuzzy.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 劳工绵似乎知道更多，可能也被压榨了更多……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Grinding Fuzzy seems to know more, and may have been taken advantage of…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 反诈绵提醒您，打工需谨慎，谨防劳务派遣！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Anti-fraud Fuzzy reminds you: Be careful when taking jobs, and watch out for labor placement scams!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前往邪恶的接头地，去揭绵的老底。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to the shady meetup spot and dig up this Fuzzy's secrets.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 找到教父绵谈谈。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Find Godfather Fuzzy and talk to him.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 你决定直接跟教父绵交涉，不要中间商赚差价！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You've decided to talk to Godfather Fuzzy directly!

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>龙堡</>击败<blue>坚甲犀兽</>
Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Crimson Castle</> and defeat <blue>Plated Rhino</>
Go to <blue>Crimson Castle</> and defeat <blue>Stone Armor</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前往龙堡完成任务吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to Crimson Castle and complete the quest!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 完成任务，回去向教父绵交付成果吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Quest complete. Time to deliver the goods to Godfather Fuzzy.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 颇有哲学思考的绵叫住你，邀请你来，打一架？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A Fuzzy with a philosophical streak calls you over for a sparring session?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 战斗结束，去找刚刚的绵领取奖励吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Battle's over. Go find the Fuzzy from before and claim your reward!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 文明绵再次叫住你参加绵击俱乐部的战斗！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Refined Fuzzy calls you back for another battle at the Fuzzy Club!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 战斗爽！去找文明绵领取奖励吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Battle was awesome! Go see Refined Fuzzy to claim your reward!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 虽然绵似乎有所变化，但总之战斗就好了吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Fuzzy seems a bit different now, but who cares? Let's keep the battle going!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 向野蛮绵领取奖励吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Claim your reward from Wild Fuzzy!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 根据野蛮绵的说法，这次的战斗好像会很……特殊？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: According to Wild Fuzzy, this battle sounds like it'll be… special?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 野蛮绵似乎有了更大的变化……不过更多的奖励……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Wild Fuzzy seems to have changed even more… but the rewards look pretty tempting…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 那是什么，那还是之前的绵吗？还要战斗吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What happened? Is that even the same Fuzzy from before? Do we still have to battle?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 与奇怪的黑绵完成战斗，究竟发生了什么？还是不要深究了吧……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The battle with the strange Fuzzy is over, but what exactly happened? Honestly… better not to ask.

PanelDescription.SourceString:
棋圣绵需要你帮助它解开残局，这一局需要一枚「兵」。
「兵」似乎在某个商绵手中。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString:
Grandmaster Fuzzy needs your help solving the endgame. A pawn is needed.
The pawn seems to be with a Fuzzy Merchant.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将所需棋子交付棋圣绵吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Deliver the required pieces to Grandmaster Fuzzy!

PanelDescription.SourceString:
棋圣绵需要你帮助它解开残局，这一局需要两枚「兵」。
「兵」似乎在某个商绵手中。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString:
Grandmaster Fuzzy needs your help solving the endgame. Two pawns are needed.
The pawns seem to be with a Fuzzy Merchant.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将所需棋子交付棋圣绵吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Deliver the required pieces to Grandmaster Fuzzy!

PanelDescription.SourceString:
棋圣绵需要你帮助它解开残局，这一局需要「兵」、「车」各一枚。
「兵」似乎在某个商绵手中，「车」似乎隐藏在冰原深处的危险之地。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString:
Grandmaster Fuzzy needs your help solving the endgame. A pawn and a rook are needed.
The pawn seems to be with a Fuzzy Merchant, while the rook seems to be hidden deep in a dangerous part of the frozen wasteland.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将所需棋子交付棋圣绵吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Deliver the required pieces to Grandmaster Fuzzy!

PanelDescription.SourceString:
棋圣绵需要你帮助它解开残局，这一局需要「车」、「马」各一枚。
「车」似乎隐藏在冰原深处的危险之地，获取「马」似乎需要为奇怪的绵展示一系列战斗。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString:
Grandmaster Fuzzy needs your help solving the endgame. A rook and a knight are needed.
The rook seems to be hidden deep in a dangerous part of the frozen wasteland, while getting the knight seems to require completing a series of battles for a strange Fuzzy.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将所需棋子交付棋圣绵吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Deliver the required pieces to Grandmaster Fuzzy!

PanelDescription.SourceString:
棋圣绵需要你帮助它解开残局，这一局需要「马」、「象」各一枚。
获取「马」似乎需要为奇怪的绵展示一系列战斗，「象」 隐藏在龙堡深处的危险之地咩。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString:
Grandmaster Fuzzy needs your help solving the endgame. A knight and a bishop are needed.
Getting the knight seems to require completing a series of battles for a strange Fuzzy, while the bishop is tucked away in a dangerous place deep in Crimson Castle, baa.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将所需棋子交付棋圣绵吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Deliver the required pieces to Grandmaster Fuzzy!

PanelDescription.SourceString:
棋圣绵需要你帮助它解开残局，这一局需要「车」、「马」、「后」各一枚。
「车」似乎隐藏在冰原深处的危险之地，获取「马」似乎需要为奇怪的绵展示一系列战斗，「后」 隐藏在一团鲜红的迷雾中咩。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString:
Grandmaster Fuzzy needs your help solving the endgame. A rook, a knight, and a queen are needed.
The rook seems to be hidden deep in a dangerous part of the frozen wasteland, while getting the knight seems to require completing a series of battles for a strange Fuzzy. The queen seems hidden somewhere in the crimson mist.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将所需棋子交付棋圣绵吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Deliver the required pieces to Grandmaster Fuzzy!

PanelDescription.SourceString:
棋圣绵需要你帮助它解开残局，这一局需要「王」、「后」、「兵」各一枚。
「王」已经在你手中，「后」 隐藏在一团鲜红的迷雾中，「兵」似乎在某个商绵手中。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString:
Grandmaster Fuzzy needs your help solving the endgame. A king, a queen, and a pawn are needed.
The king is already in your hand. The queen seems hidden somewhere in the crimson mist. The pawn seems to be with a Fuzzy Merchant.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 残局已经尽数破解，棋圣绵会拿出什么奖励来呢！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: With all the endgames cleared, what reward does Grandmaster Fuzzy have in store?!

QuestName.LocalizedString: My Hobby is Sharing Cool Obscurities!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 冰冰绵喜欢棒冰晶簇和冰纹蝶，找找看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Icy Fuzzy likes Icy Geodes and Frostvein Butterflies. See if you can find some.

QuestName.LocalizedString: My Hobby is Sharing Cool Obscurities!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 把「冷冰冰」交给冰冰绵，和它聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Give chilly stuff to Icy Fuzzy, then chat with it.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 药草绵需要迷雾果实和翠闪蝶制作草药，带一些回去吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Herbalist Fuzzy needs Misty Fruits and Emerald Butterflies to make the remedy. Bring some back.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 把草药交付给药草绵，看看它能不能做出神奇草药。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Deliver the herbs to Herbalist Fuzzy and see if it can make the magic herb.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 侦探绵想找些骑士花和幽影蝶研究一下。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Detective Fuzzy would like to find some Flowers of the Knight and Umbral Butterflies to study.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 把物品交付给侦探绵，或许有一天它真的能梦想成真呢？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Hand the items over to Detective Fuzzy—maybe one day that dream will come true.
